rounds.text: Riba Textiles faces a clear trend of deteriorating top-line performance, as evidenced by the deceleration of compounded sales growth from 9% over ten years to a contraction of 14% over the trailing twelve months [E14, E17]. This decline is further underscored by a 11% year-over-year drop in sales, suggesting that the company is struggling to maintain its market position [E67]. While the stock is currently trading at 72% of its 52-week range, the market's optimism appears disconnected from operational reality, as price growth has recently outpaced profit growth by 4% [E5, E55]. Furthermore, the company provides no return to shareholders through dividends, leaving investors with zero yield [E4]. Conceded: [E1, E2, E6, E7, E8, E64, E66]. The company's inability to sustain sales growth, which has fallen to a poor 6.11% over the past five years, casts significant doubt on the long-term viability of its current valuation [E60].
